news.text: NEW GOALS #JUVEEuro League: Four players break their drought. Including #Kolo.NEC overwhelmed at the Stadium: 5-0. First goals for #Alajbegovic, #Woltemade and #Çelik. #Nico leads the way.[Front Page Gazzetta dello Sport]

#JUVE BREAKTHROUGHAll backing LucioA five goal thrashing in Europa League: #NEC Nijmegen overwhelmed by 5-0.What a blast: #Nico, #Alajbegovic, #Woltemade, #Çelik and #KoloThe KO against #Sassuolo redeemed. The new signings take center stage. A long pass from #Grabara and a goal by #González. A gem from Kerim and a penalty from Nick. Then the Turk and the Frenchman score. #Massara reinforces #Spalletti: "The team is in excellent hands." [Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#JUVE, #NEC STANDS NO CHANCEEuropa League revitalizes the bianconeri and #Spalletti. The Dutch are overwhelmed: #Nico, #Alajbegovic, #Woltemade, #Çelik and #Kolo score.Tactically naive opponents and an error-prone goalkeeper immediately launch #González, but this time the team (deployed in the new 3-4-2-1) doesn't let go of its grip and maintains high defensive focus: finally the center-forward scored, even though the German needed a penalty. An excellent debut from #Grabara in goal: what feet![Front Page TuttoSport]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'Sky Sport': "How satisfied am I? I am extremely satisfied precisely because they took to the pitch with a clear mindset. They transformed the doubts that come after defeats like that, about the choices to be made, they chose well. Furthermore, the goals scored were also beautiful, managing to exploit their eagerness, their desire to perform, their footballing philosophy. Because when opponents come at you that hard, you shouldn't be intimidated, but instead you have to use what the others are doing and they used it well. For the first goal, drawing them out to come and press with low, short possession play, only to then go long and exploit the space. Nico #González d

🗣 Kerim #Alajbegovic to 'Sky Sport': "Am I happy with the time I had on the pitch and the progress I've made? Yes, I am very happy with the time I had on the pitch and I have to thank my coach. He is extraordinary and a great person, he gave me confidence. The team gave me confidence as well and it is truly very important for us to win and keep winning. So we must look forward and do our best".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Kerim #Alajbegovic a to 'Sky Sport': "A message to all the clubs in the Europa League? Yes, because #NEC is a good team. They played well and showed their quality in possession. It wasn't simple, but I think we did very well and showed our qualities, including individual ones. We have top players and we are really proud of this 5-0".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Kerim #Alajbegovic to 'Sky Sport': "Do I think I am growing match after match here in Turin? Yes. I managed to get this goal, last week I also came close, but the thing that makes me very proud is that we won today. Our journey in Europa League started today and we want to carry it out in the best possible way".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Kerim #Alajbegovic to 'Sky Sport': "First feelings after this match? I am really proud of my goal and I am looking forward with the team. We are extremely happy to have won 5-0 and that I was able to contribute to this result. We played very well and scored five goals without conceding any, so we want to continue like this moving forward".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Nick #Woltemade to 'Sky Sport': "Called up for the national team? Of course I'm very happy. Playing for Germany is always beautiful, it's a great nation with strong players, so clearly I'm very happy and excited to meet all the new guys too. But first there is an important match on Sunday and after that I'll think about the national team, so I am excited".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Nick #Woltemade to 'Sky Sport': "Italy? Obviously everything is very new to me. We are in a completely new country, with a new language. I don't speak Italian yet and I have to find a new apartment, for now I'm staying in a hotel, so every week I'm learning something new. I'm still not satisfied with how I'm playing, I want to keep improving and then I think I can truly help the team".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Nick #Woltemade to 'Sky Sport': "How much can this goal help me? Honestly, you can play well as much as you want, but for a striker scoring goals is always the most important thing. So this will help me settle in and build up my self-confidence. I am very happy and I thank my teammate who let me take the penalty".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Nick #Woltemade to 'Sky Sport': "Happy with the match? What is my first impression after this victory? Yes, I am really happy, obviously, especially with the good result. Winning at home is always positive. No football match is simple, we did quite well. We knew it would be a tough game and I think we did pretty well. Obviously, I am very happy to have scored my first goal. Overall, it was a beautiful night for me".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Nico #Gonzalez to 'Sky Sport': "Did I leave the penalty ball to #Woltemade? It is important for our striker, also for #Kolo... They need goals, they live for that. Let's hope this is just the beginning for them, because it is far too important".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Nico #Gonzalez to 'Sky Sport': "What does this mean for me after a summer where there was so much talk about my future? Yes, today I feel great in this team, thanks also to the Mister who trusts me. I show it on the pitch because this is where I have fun, thanks also to the team that trusts me to do what I do. It's a long season and let's hope we continue like this".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Nico #Gonzalez to 'Sky Sport': "Did I kick off this evening and did we have fun? Yes, we needed this win, to play good football, we had four high intensity training sessions. We played a great game, doing exactly what we worked on this week and in the end these three points stay here".[@juventusinsidernews]
